editorial_identity: Institutional, premium, confident tone similar to LSE, Nasdaq, Clearstream, Euroclear, Financial Times.

primary.name: Deep Midnight Blue
primary.usage: Main backgrounds for dark sections, primary text in light sections, solid headers, footer background.

accent.name: Discreet Bronze/Gold
accent.usage: Primary CTAs, delicate borders, active states, key icons, underline accents. Use sparingly to maintain premium feel.

background.usage: Off-white/warm gray for main page backgrounds to reduce eye strain and feel editorial.

surface.usage: Cards, dropdowns, bento boxes. Must maintain high contrast with text.

rules: No purple or violet gradients allowed.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure gray. Always tint grays with the primary blue hue.
High contrast text visibility is mandatory.
Headings must use Newsreader (or equivalent premium serif like Fraunces). NOT Inter/Roboto.
Body must use IBM Plex Sans (or equivalent clean sans). NOT Inter/Roboto.
Never center-align large blocks of text.
Overlines should use the accent color (#C9A961) for section kickers.

spacing_scale.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs for an editorial, premium breathing room.

grids_layouts.bento_grid: Use asymmetric bento grids (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4) for the Modules and About values sections.
grids_layouts.editorial_columns: Use 2-column or 3-column strict layouts for industries and text-heavy sections, similar to Financial Times.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align text by default. Only center for specific hero statements.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C9A961] text-[#0A1628] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-[#b5954a] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-[#0A1628] text-[#0A1628] px-6 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-[#0A1628] hover:text-white transition-colors dark:border-[#C9A961] dark:text-[#C9A961] dark:hover:bg-[#C9A961] dark:hover:text-[#0A1628]

cards.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), subtle 1px border. No soft, cheap shadows. Use solid crisp backgrounds.

header.style: Sticky, condenses on scroll. Solid background (bg-[#0A1628] or bg-[#F8F7F4] based on theme). Mega-menu for Solutions/Industries.

forms.style: Minimalist, bottom-border only (flair inputs) or very crisp rectangular inputs. Use shadcn/ui but styled flat.

cookie_banner.style: IAB TCF 2.2 compliant style. Fixed bottom, full width, sharp edges, dark theme.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use fine 1px borders to separate content, evoking print newspapers and stock exchange tables.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on dark sections to give a matte, institutional feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5. No emojis.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for momentum and premium feel.
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle fade-ins (opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0). No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.hero: WebGL or CSS subtle ambient animation or muted autoplay demo video. Do NOT distract from the authority.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA/APCA. Text on dark backgrounds must be legible.

media_imagery.direction: Photography must evoke Dubai (skyline, financial architecture), Africa (growing markets, professional diversity), technology (dashboards, data-viz). Never generic stock photos.
media_imagery.treatments: Images should have a subtle contrast boost or a faint multiply blend to match the editorial palette.

Dubai skyline at sunset, representing the financial hub.
Diverse team in an office in Africa.

Abstract metallic bronze geometry to be used as background textures.

section_guidelines.Homepage: Animated hero (dark theme, #0A1628), Value prop section with metrics, Modules bento grid, Industries carousel, Logo wall of regulators/partners.
section_guidelines.About: History timeline, dual interactive maps (Dubai + Africa), Founder profile block, sharp Values bento tiles, prominent Trust Signals (Licenses).
section_guidelines.Solutions: Standardized template: Hero -> Arch Diagram -> Feature Grid -> Screenshots. Use tabs for deep dives.
section_guidelines.Industries: 5 verticals. Layout: Challenges (left column) / Solutions (right column). Case studies at bottom.
section_guidelines.Investors: Public intro. Gated area simulating auth for Pitch Deck download, NDA, Calendly integration.
section_guidelines.Technology: 5 pillars using a technical mono-spaced aesthetic mixed with serif headings. Architecture diagrams.
section_guidelines.Blog: Insights hub with editorial layout. Search autocomplete, tags, reading progress bar, newsletter CTA.
section_guidelines.Contact: Multi-step or tabbed form for 6 intents. Map of Dubai HQ.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React + Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui components.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals and staggered lists.
Set up dual routing or state-based i18n for EN/FR toggle.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Space Grotesk' fonts. Import 'Newsreader' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts.
Build custom components for Architecture diagrams using HTML/CSS grid or simple SVGs, avoiding generic layouts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
No purple/blue gradients or generic 'SaaS' vibes. Stick to the locked palette: #0A1628 and #C9A961.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces solid/flat (not heavily blurred).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text reading flow must be natural.
Use sharp, rectangular modern button styles (rounded-none or rounded-sm). No pill shapes.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
NEVER use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image_urls.
